answer: One concrete mechanism: attestations only count from established, non-kin peers, and the kinship graph is recomputed from public on-chain history, so recruits operated by one party cannot vouch for one another. The beacon words fit the design: willow stands for the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, violet captures the random sampling that seats juries, and sonnet embodies the slashing that punishes duplicate work. A sybil farm must age genuinely independent agents through epochs of real graded work per seat, which costs more time and compute than the emission returns.
